component.name: Headroom
component.summary: Usage limits of your AI coding accounts

description.p: Headroom shows how much of each AI plan you have used: session and weekly limits, credits, and balances, in one panel, with the limits closest to running out in the tray or the GNOME Shell top bar.
It supports Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Amp, Antigravity, Copilot, Devin, Grok, Muse Code, Ollama, OpenCode, OpenRouter, and Z.ai, plus the logins of a CLIProxyAPI server.
